subject: Taxes
title: Taxes When You Work Abroad
description: A quick win: understand Taxes When You Work Abroad.

hook.text: The US is one of only two countries that taxes citizens on worldwide income—even if you live and work abroad.

buildup.text: An American working in Paris pays French income tax AND owes US taxes. Double taxation is a real possibility.

discovery.text: The Foreign Earned Income Exclusion lets you exclude up to $126,500 of foreign earnings. Foreign tax credits help too.

twist.text: The US and Eritrea are the only countries with citizenship-based taxation. Every other nation taxes by residency.

climax.text: Thousands of Americans renounce citizenship annually—partly to escape worldwide taxation.

punchline.text: Live in Tokyo, pay US taxes. Only two countries do this worldwide.

quiz.question: Besides the US, which other country taxes citizens on worldwide income?
